mapper.select: select code,name,type,dept,unit,life,amount,use_status,review_status,approval_date from asset_info where type = #{type} and review_status = 1
select name from asset_category where level = #{level};
select COUNT(*) from asset_info WHERE max_type = #{maxType};
select SUM(amount) from asset_info WHERE max_type = #{maxType};
mapper.insert: insert into asset.asset_info(code, name, type, max_type,dept,unit,life,amount,use_status,review_status,approval_date) values (#{code},#{name},#{type},#{maxType},#{dept},#{unit},#{life},#{amount},#{useStatus},#{reviewStatus},#{approvalDate})
